article.story: POUGHKEEPSIE, N.Y. -- — Jadin Collins had 14 points in Marist’s 58-57 win against Bryant on Tuesday. Collins also contributed five rebounds and three steals for the Red Foxes (3-3). Jack Graham scored 13 points while shooting 4 of 7 from the field and 5 for 7 from the line. Graham's go-ahead basket with 26 seconds left were the game's final points. Jordan Gabriel shot 4 of 11 from the field and 2 for 3 from the line to finish with 10 points for Marist. Keegan Harvey led the way for the Bulldogs (3-5) with 19 points and six rebounds. Eric Chatfield Jr. added 15 points for Bryant. Andre Pasha finished with 12 points and two blocks. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
